tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan ces bya ba'i bstan bcos bzhugs so//

rgyal dbang mkhyen pa'i chu gter gyis spros pa'i// snying rje'i nam mkhar kun tu bzang po'i 'od// kun tu 'phro ba'i nyi ma 'jam pa'i dbyangs// snying gi mun pa'i gshed ma der phyag 'tshal// ston pa bstan dang de 'dzin thams cad kyang*// skyon med yon tan mnga' ba 'ba' zhig gis// 'jig rten gsum gyis mchod 'os nyid gyur pa// zas gtsang sras kyi ring lugs de la 'dud// thub pa de yi gzhung gi chu gter du// bslab gzhi'i rin chen ci yang bskrun pa rnams// mkhas grub klu dbang bye bas yongs gzung ba// ris med 'gro la bgo bshar bdag gis bya// so so thar dang de bzhin sems bskyed dang*// rig pa 'dzin pa zhes bya'i sdom pa gsum// rim pa bzhin du nyan thos byang sems dang*// de bzhin gshegs pa'i 'dul ba yin par bsgrags// lus ngag nyes pa tsam zhig spong byed pa'i// tshul khrims so so thar yin dbye ba gang*// brgyad bzhi gnyis te len pa'i cho ga la// sngon dang da ltar gnyis su gnang ba yin// skyabs su 'gro ba rtsom pas dge bsnyen du// khas blangs de la bslab pa'i gzhi lnga sbyin// zhu dang mkhan por gsol dang dang po dang*// rab byung dge tshul grib tshod bslab pa brjod// sangs rgyas chos dang dge slong dge 'dun la// kha skong chos ldan mi mthun gnyis dang bral// dbus su bcu dang mtha' khob lnga las ni// nyung bar mi rung slob dpon bzhi las 'dir// gsang ston las byed gnyis so dang por bya// lo bcu lon dang lhan cig sbyar ldan pa'i// mkhan po chos gos gsum dang lhung bzed sbyin// skye gnas khyad par mdzes pa'i bar chad med// spro bya gsol dang gsang ston zhu ba dang*// gsol dang gsol ba dri 'dod gsol ba dang*// las dang gzhal dang dus lnga go byed dang*// yin min phan yon gnas dang ltung ba dang*// dge sbyong mchog 'dod mnyam dang tshul 'brel dang*// dul dang dgos dang ma brjod gus pa dang*// bsgrub par bya brjod dag tu bsdus pa yin// bud med la ni dge slob ma zhes pa'i// tshigs gzhan dge slong ma drug bcu gnyis dbus// dang po mkhan mo bslab pa'i sdom pa gsol// gsol ba gnyis kyi las dang grib tshod dang*// bslab pa brjod pa spyad dus lo gnyis so// dang por bya dang mkhan mo chos gos lnga// lhung bzed spro bya gsol dang gsang ston dang*// zhu gsol gsol ba dri dang gsol ba dang*// gnyis kyi las kyis tshangs spyod nyer gnas byin// gnyis ka'i dge 'dun nang du gsol du gzhug

/gsol ba dri dang gsol ba las kyis so// dus tshod brjod dang gnas dang lhung ba dang*// lci chos dge sbyong 'dod dang mchog 'dod dang*// mnyam dang tshul 'brel dul dang dgos pa dang*// ma brjod gus dang bsgrub byas bsdus par bshad// snga ma ma song bsnyen par rdzogs pa des// gzhan gnyis zhar gyis thob pa mdo sder snang*/ des dus kun slong sems bskyed kyis zin na// theg chen so so thar par mkhas rnams bzhed// bzhi min gnas pas gnas la ma zhus min// des kyang gdam ngag sogs kyis phan gdags bya// mi tshangs spyod dang brku dang mi gsod dang*// bla ma'i brdzun bzhi phas pham ltung ba'i sde// shin tu lci phyir 'di dag gang 'byung kyang*// dge slong rnam par nyams par 'gyur ba yin// 'jigs dang ngo tsha med dang chags pa yis// cha kun gzung bzod sbyor rung lam ma nyams// kha shun so pags las phar nad med kyi// nor bu las rung drud bde myong ba na'o// sems skyes yid yin kha la reg pa'i bar// sbyor ltung mtshams las 'das na dngos gzhir 'gyur// 'khrig la 'du shes gtso min bzlog pa la// mi skrag lci ba mi nyan rab lci dang*// gzhan la khrel yod yang dang rang nyid la// ngo tsha shin tu yang ba'o de dag ni// phas pham gyis blang sbom po bzhir bshad do// rku sems mir rdzas 'du shes mi gzhan nor// yul dus rin thang tshang ba mis bzung bsams// de nyid sbyor gcig bdag don ma byin par// brkus sam rkur bcug rtsad la'o dad pas min// brku la sems gtso de bral nyes med yin// yan lag lhag ma nyams pa sbom por 'gyur// mtshams las ma brgal sbyor ba'i ltung ba dang*// brgal ba mthar 'gyur dur khrod mi dbang zas// sho gam yul chos chad pa mi 'jal sogs// sbom por gsungs la lci yang gong bzhin sbyar// gang du ma shā ka ni nyi shu la// karsha pa na yin na ma sha ka /lnga la tshang zhing bcu drug la bzhi dang*// bcu gnyis la gsum bzhi bcu la bcu ste// kun kyang pa na'i bzhi char gcig pa yin// mang po'i skal ba brkus tshe re re'i skal// rin thang longs na mtha' yin mang pos brkus// de tshe rang skal rin thang brtsi bar gsungs// mi nyid gzhan bsams der 'du shes pa dang*// 'khrul med sbyor byas shi na'o yan lag gcig

/ma tshang na yang sbom po nyid du 'gyur// sems 'khrugs tshor bas gzir la ltung ba med// gsod du 'jug dang mtshon sbyin thabs gzhan dang*// lus ngag yi rang 'chir bsngags rkyen byas mtha'// lag pa gcod dang nang par 'chi sems kyi// rjes mthun bsgrub sogs chung ngur shes par bya// bla ma brjod blos bsam gtan la sogs dang*// mngon shes 'bras bcas yon tan rnam mang 'dir// mi chos bla ma zhes bya de bdag la// yod ces mi la brdzun smras gzhan gyis ni// go la'i mngon pa'i nga rgyal ma gtogs so// lus kyis go byed ngag gis ma smras na// nyes byas tsam ste brdzun gyi ltung ba'i rten// tshig yin 'bras bu la rton dngos su dang*// de chos thob las yongs su nyams brjod mtha'// 'dre mthong zhi gnas gzhan la snyad btags dang*// don mthun zur gyis gleng dang phyi ma dag /ma smra dang du len na sbom po yin// khu ba 'dzin dang 'khrig tshig bsnyen bkur smyan// khang pa khang chen dang ni gzhi med dang*// bag tsam dge 'dun dbyen dang de rjes phyogs// khyim sun 'byin dang bka' blo mi bde ba// lhag ma'i sde yin kun tu dge 'dun gyis// dag bya lhag ma'i ltung ba nyid phyir ro// bsams bzhin sems can bgrang rung yan lag la// reg dang rtsol bas khu ba phyung ba na'o// las lam ma rdzogs sbyor ba rdzogs na dngos// shes bzhin 'byin pa gzhan ni sbom po dang*// chu bti mthong nas chags gtong nyes byas te// nad sogs rang bzhin 'dzag pa nyes med yin// chags pas bud med rung la ma chod reg /bde myong na yin tshur la reg pas kyang*// gzhan ni na smad skyabs dang sems dag pa// nyes med dud 'gro mo sogs nyes byas so// 'khrig don bud med mdun du 'khrig tshig smras// brda 'phrod na'o dngos sgra mi brjod na// sbom po'o tshur smra dang du blang ba'ang mtshungs// rten rung bud med 'dun pa bdag nyid dang*// 'khrig brjod bsngags go bsngags la yi rang la'o// dngos min ris 'dra brjod pa sbom po dang*// brten mi bzod la nyes byas yin zhes byos// sprad bya ma 'khrul sprad 'dod rang gzhan dang*// phrin gyis bud med skyes sprad phrad na'o// chung ma bdun la 'thab tshigs bdun rim bzhin// dang po gsum la dang gsum bsdums nyes byas// bar gsum na smad lhag ma dngos gzhi yin// mdza' na mo bcu chung ma'i dang po gsum// ma gtogs kun la 'thab tshigs bdun thams cad// dngos gzhir 'gyur zhing na smad 'gyur ba med// bdag yod ma gsol ma bstan gzhi dang ni// brtsam du mi rung rtsod pa dang bcas par// tshad las lhag pa'i rang gi khang byas la'o// yan lag lnga tshang sbom po gzhan na smad// srid du bcu gnyis zheng du bdun gyi grangs// bde gshegs mtho ste de tshad khru gcig dang*// phyed yin der ni spyod lam bzhi spyad rung*// bdag med ma gsol ma bstan gzhi dang ni// brtsam du mi rung rtsod bcas sa la ni// tshogs kyi don du gtsug lag khang byas la'o// yan lag gcig dman sbom po gzhan na smad// rgyu mtshan med par gzhan ni smad 'dod pas// pham pa'i skur tshig smras pa'o nyams la yang*// de bzhin snyad ka cung zad yod pa la// brten nas smra ba bag tsam yin par grags// mthun pa dbye slad rtsod pa blangs nas gzung*// bzhams dang gsol bzhis lan gsum bsgoms mi nyan// tshogs su longs pa phye zhing bye ba na'o// bzhams te bsgo bas mi bzlog nyes byas dang*// gsol bzhi gcig gi sbom po bskyar ba yang*// gsum pas ma bzlog lhag ma'o rim pa 'di// 'og ma gsum la'ang sbyar bar bya ba yin// gang yang der rjes 'brang ba'i sdig lta can// bzhams dang gsol bzhis bzlog byas ma bzlog na'o// 'grogs dang longs spyod kyis sun 'byin pa dag

/mthong thos shes pa bskrad na dge 'dun la// skur 'debs bzhams bsgo gsol brjod kyis mi gtong*// gleng ba nyid na bdag nyid dge slong dag /brjod par mi bya ba nyid byed pa yang*// spang ltung 'ba' zhig pa gnyis ltung ba'i sde// 'di spyad ngan 'gror ltung bar byed pa'i phyir// 'chang bral zla dang 'khrur 'jug len pa dang*// slong dang slong bar rigs pa dpags pa slong*// so so bskur ba srin bal cha gnyis dang*// drug dang mtho gang lam dang rmel ba dang*// gser dngul mngon mtshan can dang nyo tshong dang*/ 'chang tshol 'thag 'jug skyed dang byin 'phrog dang*// brtad pa las byung dgon pa ras chen dang*// bsngos dang gsog 'jog spang ba'i ltung bar gsungs// rung gos lhag po tshad longs ma 'brel zhing*// 'brel kyang shan zhugs 'chang 'dod zhag bcu las// lhag bcangs 'chang ba'i spang ltung ma bting la'o// lhung bzed dra ba phor bu mtshungs pa yin// rang rdzas rang gir shes la'o gzhan rdzas la// rang gi'am som nyi nyes byas gzhan nyid kyir// rang gir gzhan shes la gnyis nyes pa med// gzhan bgrod gnang ba ma thob byin rlabs min// sra brkyang bting min chos gos nub gcig bral// 'bral spang gyis gos med pa dag la min// ma btings gang rung med cing rgyu yi gos// mi ldang kha snon re bcas 'brel min 'brel// shan zhugs 'chang 'dod sum cu las lhag pa'i// skya rengs shar bcangs 'jog pa'ang zla spang ngo*// nye min rab byung ma la 'brel ba'i gos// rnying pa 'khrur bcug la'o som nyi nyes// nye min dge slong mar bsams chos gos blangs// lon na'o brje chos dbul por nyes pa med// khyim pa nye du min la chos gos tshad// phrogs rlag tshig khyer min pas blangs lon la'o// med pas stod g.yogs smad g.yogs tshad ldan pa// zung lhag blangs pa thob la'o rjes gnang min// nye min khyim gcig brtag rung dran brjod gos// rin mdangs khru tshad kyis slong thob na yin// nye min khyim pa mang por brtag dran brjod// bslangs pa sbyor ba gcig pas thob pa la'o// phrogs pa sogs la gnyis ka nyes med yin// gsum char khyim pa mi yin mi rung spangs// dri bstan bsgos shing smras pa byung ba'i mthar// rjes brjod bskul ba drug rdzogs gos thob la'o// mthar ster spang brjod sbyin por rin long smra// ma go bskul min gus na len nyes med// dkon pa'i srin bal gsar stan byed dang 'dod// byed 'jug bkram pa nyid la'o 'dres pa la// na smad rnying spyod byas zin ltung med do// de bzhin lug bal gsar pa nag po yang*// bal gsar dkar 'khob phyed las nag po nyid// lhag la'o bsams dang gnang ba ma thob dang*// yod bzhin lo drug nang du stan byas la'o// gding ba gsar par bde gshegs mtho gang tsam// rnying pa snon las dbri na yod nus la'o// grong 'gro rgyang grags dgon nas dgon dpag tshad// gzhan med gsum tshun 'das bal khur las so// zhwa sogs ched du nyung khyer nyes pa med// nye min dge slong ma bal rmel bcug la'o// rung ba ma byas gser sogs rin chen la// reg gam reg 'jug len 'dod lon pa la'o// snod sogs snyad btags la min chos gos dang*// lam rgyags sman gyi rgyu ni rung bar gsungs// me dang chu don shel 'chang lhung bzed ni// lcags dang sa las byas min bdag gir min// de med spyad dgos byung la sman phor gsungs// rnyed 'dod sbyor ba las gcig skyed byung na'o// rang don khe spogs 'dod tshod grub pa la'o// gnyis po dkon mchog don la nyes pa med// rung ba'i lhung bzed 'brel min zhag bcu las// lhag pa rang don bcangs la'o shan zhugs kyang*// lhan pa lnga med spyad bzod yod bzhin du// lhung bzed gsar pa gzhan tshol grub pa na'o// 'brel med brims pa bcangs la nyes pa med// nye min gla rngan med par 'thag bcug la'o// sbyin pos bsgos las rang gi bskyed grub la'o// dge slong la sbyin dus gzhan khro ba yis// lus ngag gis phrogs de lus de bral la'o// brtad pa lnga la bdag gir bya sngas dang*// bgo sngas phyis la'o sbyin pa'i tshig nyes med// btings min dgon pa ba ni 'jigs bcas kyi// rang dang mtshams gcig chos gos gnas las grong*// gzhan du zhag bdun skya rengs shar ba la'o// khyim pa nye du min la sos ka'i zla// phyi ma las sngar 'dod blangs thob pa dang*// dgag dbye zin nas zla phyed lhag bcangs la'o// dge 'dun bsngos nor shes bzhin bdag gir 'dod// rang la bsgyur brtson dbang bar gyur ba na'o// khang gnyis gso sbyong tha dad rnyed thun gsungs// sman bzhi bza' ched byin rlabs byin len byas// rang ched 'dod pas brtsams shing dus yol la'o// brdzun skyon phra ma skyo sngogs ston dang 'don// gnas ngan mi chos skur 'debs khyad du gsod// sa bon 'phya bsgo gnas 'ding bskrod phyis gnon// rtsa dbyung 'debs pa rim pa gnyis su brtsig

/ma bskos nyi nub zas dang gos byed dang*// gos byin don mthun grur 'jug gcig 'dug 'greng*// sbyor bcug yang yang 'dug gnas lhag par len// gcig stobs 'dus dang dus min gsog 'jog dang*// byin len ma byas bsod pa srog chags bcas// 'dug 'greng gcer bu dmag blta nang du gnas// myong dang brdeg gzas 'chab dang gcod du 'jug /me reg 'dun pa ma rdzogs lta mi gtong*// rjes phyogs bsnyil sdud kha ma bsgyur ba dang*// longs pa'i gzhir gtogs khrus dang dud 'gro 'gyod// ga ga rtse dang lhan cig spangs byed sbed// phyin pas skur 'debs bud med rkun ma dang*// nyi shu ma lon bsko dang mgron du gnyer// bslab dang nyan rna mi smra ma gus tshul// chang 'thung dus min grong rgyu nub mo dang*// bslab gzhi khyad gsod khab ral khri rkang dang*// shing bal gding g.yan ras chen bde gshegs gos// ltung byed 'ba' zhig pa ste dgu bcur gsungs// shes bzhin bzhi min brdzun smras go las so// mthun la skyon bdun rung min smras so 'dod// dge slong 'byed tshig go na'o rtsod pa bzhi// zhi byed chog rdzogs skyo sngogs bzhi min la'o// grogs med bud med la lnga drug brtsams lha// ston na drug min pa la'o nyan slob min// ma rdzogs cig car 'dod ston ma gnang bar// gnas ngan len ltung ma rdzogs par brjod do// 'phags min ma rdzogs pa la bden nyid kyi// mi chos bla ma brjod pa'o rdzu 'phrul yang*// rung bar byas la shes ngor dge 'dun rdzas// gang zag la sbyin zer na'o 'dod pas bslab// phra ba khyad gsod 'dul la'o nyams byed blos// sa bon lnga skyes mi gtong 'joms pa la'o// bcu gnyis gang zag la 'phya zhogs 'phya byed// bgrangs la'o bsgo ba rna la gzon pa yi// grangs su bcug la'o mi smra gzon nyes byas// dge 'dun gnas mal ma bcol gyi nar bor// phan phun gyur 'das la'o g.yar bsrung dang*// brtul dang gus pa rim bzhin nyes dmigs sar// bting rtswa ma bsdus ma bcol phan phun 'das// sdang bas khang skrod thon na'o bcol 'jug kyang*// sngar zhugs shes bzhin mtho 'tsham phyis mnan na'o// gtsug lag khang thog rnyi bar khri rkang no// 'dod pas gtsugs pa thal byung song ba na'o// srog chags bcas chu spyad don phyir 'debs la'o// mi brtan ma gtod khang brtsig rim nyin lhag

/gsum min na'o ma bskos dge slong mar// chos ston pa la'o shes bzhin nyi nub yang*// 'dod sred min la zas ngor ston smras so// nye min dge slong ma yi gos bzos dang*// gos sbyin yang ngo 'di la bzhi nyes med// dge slong ma dang gcig lam grur 'jug kyang*// 'jigs bcas nyes med zhar la sbyin len gnang*// dben par bud med dang bcas gcig bur 'dug /'greng yang nye min ma gnyer dge slong mas// sbyor bcug zos la'o dus yon nyes pa med// gnang min nye min khyim las zas gnyis zos// khyim gzhan mu stegs kyir gtogs zhag gcig las// lhag gnas zos na'o ci bder min nye du// min la rab do blangs pa'o zos zin spangs// lhag por ma byas bca' bza' 'cha' 'am zos// ngan sems kyis brdzun bstabs na des zos tshe'o// gnang min mtshams nang las logs 'dus zos so// rang gnas phyed yol skya rengs ma shar bar// dus rung zas zos pa la'o gnang la min// cho ga gcig sman bzhi gsog 'jog byas zos la'o// lag nya mtshams btsos zhag lon zhar las yin// rung min byin len lngas min zhig shes zos// nye min khyim par bsod pa'i zas blangs zos// rung ba lnga min chu la spyad pa gnyis// gang rung spyad la'o bltar yod shi de snyed// khron pa chu tshags lnga dang dge slong dang*/ dge 'dun yid ches de yi rung ba lnga'o// brnag pas nyal po bshom khyim 'dug pa dang*// 'greng ba'o 'jigs dang ma tshor tha dad min// 'di med bltos min btang min de la ni// rung zas rang gis byin nam 'jug pa la'o// g.yul la blta dang nang gnas reg bshams pa// dkrug dang blta ched mtshams las 'das pa la'o// gsum kar rkyen dbang nyes med sdang bas brdeg /'phog na'o de snyed ltung 'byung brdeg par gzas// tshor na'o dbang min grogs ltung nyin mtshan mthar// 'chab na'o ched du sbyin po zan gcod bcug /dus min me la reg dang dge 'dun gyi// las la 'dun pa phul ba phyir slog smras// ma gnang ma rdzogs lhan cig gnas bzhir zhag

/gsum pa'i skya rengs shar tshun nyal ba la'o// chos 'gar sdig lta skyes bsgo smad pa na'o// dge slong gnas dbyung bar smra yang dag dang*// gnas longs gcig byed dge tshul bsnyil la yang*// ma bsgyur gos gyon pa la'o dgos pa'i phyir// rung gyur rin chen g.yul dang rol mo'i chas// skud rgyan rag gam 'jug glu gar byed la'o// chos ldan gzhan gyir bsngor rung nyes pa med// rnyed na bdag por de med dge 'dun rdzas// gnang min 'jug ngogs rung min ril por bkrus// dud 'gro gsod dam gsod bcug shi ba na'o// rdzogs la dge slong min don 'gyod skyes la'o// g.ya' bar bya sems ga ga tshil byed la'o// dga' bas chu la rtsed 'jo min la yang*// ma bsrung bud med lan cig nyal mtshan mthar// sngangs 'dod 'jigs rgyus go na'o 'di pa dbang*// 'tsho ba'i yo byad sbed dam 'jug phan min// byin pa slar spyad gzhi des dga' min la'o// 'dod pas lhag ma'i skur brjod bag tsam kyang*// 'dod pas bud med lhan cig lam 'gro ba// phan phyir min la'o rkun ma yang de bzhin// ma lon rdzogs na'o ma gnang sa brkos pa'o// bos pa bzhi min gnyer min blangs zos na'o// bslab bskul mi shes nyid brjod go ba na'o// rtsod phyir gros la nyan rna byas go na// zhi 'dod ma gtogs chos ldan las la 'dus// ma smras 'gro na nyen kor 'das pa na'o// dge 'dun gyis bsgo shad sbyang med slog la'o// 'bru 'am bcos ma'i chang ni myos 'gyur 'thung*// rkyen min phyi dro grong 'gro 'das pa la'o// bos der ma sleb ma bsgo 'dod pas grong*// snga dro gsum dang phyi dro bzhir rgyus la'o// nam la rgyal po'i khab tu phyin pa na'o// 'don pa 'di yod da gzod shes smra na// rmongs min na'o rin che'i khab ral bzos// dge 'dun mal khri rkang tshad lhag byas dang*/ de mal bal bdal gding ba g.yan pa dgab// ras chen chos gos tshad las lhag byed rnams// dge slong ma gral bslab pa nags brtag pa// sor bshags sde yin so sor bshags bya'i phyir// nye min dge slong ma la grong du zas// blangs pa gnyis char gnas zos gang nye dus// gnyer min khyim du dge slong mas bsgo bshams// ma bzlog zos so shes gtso bslab pa'i sdom// sbyin las rung min blangs zos 'jigs bcas su// ma bsnyil phyi rol dgon par blangs zos la'o// gos bgo bcu dang spyod yul 'gro nyi shu// 'dug dgu zas blang brgyad dang za nyer gcig

/lhung bzed bcu bzhi chos bstan nyer drug dang*// bsgrub pa'i tshul gsum rgyu gcig nyes byas sde// 'di spyad nyes byas nyid phyir bzlog ste bslab// sham thabs ci nas zlum min brtsengs dang 'jol// glang sna ltebs dang phur ma gdengs ka 'dra// stod g.yogs zlum min brtsengs 'jol khyim 'gro na// ma bsdams bgos bskyungs mig g.yeng gang tsam min// mgo g.yogs brdzes gzar gnya' gong ltag par bsnol// mchong brkyang tsog bu brang ba dkur brten dang*// lus bsgyur lag skyog mgo bsgyur phrag sprad sbrel// stan la ma bsgo ma brtags lcid phab dang*// rkang pa brla bsnol long bu long bur bzhag /rkang dgug gdangs dang 'doms snang 'gram stan thabs// legs par ma blangs mu da kha cha mnyam// mthar chags min dang lta min ma 'ongs bzed// lhag por 'dod dgab steng du snod gzung dang*// 'gal zos kham chung che dang ran par min// kha gdangs bkang ste smra ba tsug tsug dang*// cag cag hu hu phu phu lce phyung za// 'bru nan tha dad 'phyas gdags mgur ba spo// rkan tog kham 'phro bcad dang lag pa bldag /'byong dang lag sprug snod bskyom 'dra byas gzhom// 'phyas gdags phyir blta 'bags pas chu snod 'dzin// 'bags chu gzhan gtor ma dris khyim du dbo// lhag blugs gzhi med gad g.yang gzar por bzhag /'greng gang g.yang gzar rgyun 'bab drag por bkrus// 'greng nyal dma' bar 'dug dang phyi nas 'ong*// lam gyi 'gram sogs do ker zhwa cod pan// phreng dang dkris dang glang po rta dang bzhon// mchil lham 'khar gdugs mtshon cha ral gri dang*// dgra cha go cha gyon pa rnams la bshad// 'greng chu sngo bcas sa la bshang gci dor// shing la mi gang mthor 'dzeg gnang la min// mi tshangs spyod len gsod smra reg pa dang*// lus bkan 'chab dang bzlog pa pham pa brgyad// smyan byed gzhi med bag tsam cha bcas len// len 'jug mtshan 'bral nyin 'bral lam la 'jug

/chu brgal rab 'byin shi nor bzod byed dang*// spong dang 'thab krol brten pa brten du 'jug /dge 'dun dbyen dang der phyogs khyim sun 'byin// bka' blo mi bde nyi shu lhag ma yin// spang ltung so gsum ltung byed brgya brgyad cu// sor bshags bcu gcig nyes byas brgya bcu gnyis// rtsa ba drug dang rjes mthun chos drug po// dge slob ma la lhag po'o dge tshul ni// gang zhig srog gcod gzhan gyi nor 'phrog dang*// mi tshangs spyod brdzun bcos ma'i chang la sogs// gar sogs phreng sogs mal chen mtho ba dang*// phyi dro'i kha zas dngul nyid spong ba ste// gnang ba nyes med bcu gsum ma gtogs pa// 'dir bstan blangs pa'i phyogs mthun shes par byos// rtsa bzhi chang dang lnga spong dge bsnyen la// tshul khrims bag yod brtul zhugs yan lag brgyad// mi dge lhag drug gnyis ga'i phyogs mthun yin// rnam dag la gsungs bslab pa byin par 'dra// der ltos ma rdzogs nyams dang ma chags sbyor// nyes byas tshigs gzhan blangs 'das phyogs mthun yang*// gzhan gyi rnam rten la skyed 'du shes dgos// tshigs lngar sbyor byas phyi mar na smad nyid// dkon pa'i rdzas bkag bzang dang rin 'dra mtshungs// mtshan gyur de yi zhing yin che las chung*// med las yod min yod las med 'gyur brtsi// gzhi gcig dur bcas de nyid kun slong gi /de cha der gtogs chung min tha dad 'bras// ltung min kha na ma tho smad pa de'i// ltung ba'ang na smad rmi lam nyes med yin// khyim babs phul ba slar rdzogs btang la min// ci rigs thun mong bstan pas spyir bstan gsungs// spong ba'i zhal ta bsko zhing spong khang brtsig /bsdu phyir gaṇḍi brdung zhing brdung ba lnga// gso sbyong gi ni gnas la blo mthun bya// dpag tshad phyed gsum mtshams chen phyogs bzhi ru// mtshan ma brtan gzugs dris tsig dge 'dun la// bsgo nas thams cad 'dug cing mthun gyur tshe// btsugs pa go byas gcig gis gsal ba dang*// las kyi mtshams chen bcad la chos gos dang*// mi 'bral gnang ba sbyin no mi mkho na// mtshams chen bkrol la 'tshams bu chung bcad cing*// 'dod na chos gos mi 'bral gnang ba'ang sbyin// chung ngu bcings der mtshams chen slar bcad gnang*// gnyis kar dge 'dun bkod de las byed pa'i// tshig gis mtshams gnyis cig car dgrol ba dang*// bcad nas gnang ba sbyin bzhi yang na ba// med phul gyur dang skya rengs las kyis 'jig

/ma bcad las la brtsig pa mtshams yin la// ma bskor wa ka chu 'dzag gang 'bab tshun// grong la nyen kor dgon par rgyang grags mtha'// mtshams der gtogs pa'i dkyil 'khor pa thams cad// las la 'du bya mi mthun byed 'gal tshabs// de nang chos gos med pas 'gyod mi bya// 'du bar mi nus pa la yongs dag 'dun// rim pa'am cig car blang ngo rgyal pos gzung*// mtshams nang 'dug na pho nya las tha dad// brtsams la phan tshun phul bas mthun pa 'grub// glo bur 'ongs 'bod myos la gnang ba sbyin// ltung ba can rnams las la 'jug pa'i sngon/ bshags bsdam byin brlab dge 'dun ltung ba mthun// yid gnyis rtsod dang des nyid ma yin na// grub na'o min na gsol ba 'ba' zhig pas// byin brlab las zhugs dran dang yid gnyis za// gzhan gyi drung na mo dang las byed yid// zhi gnas mthun pa'i gso sbyong phyi mar lnga// ra ba tha chung 'bring gnyis gnam stong ni// zhag mi thub pas gso sbyong bcu bzhi pa// lhag ma bco lnga par bzhag zla ba'i shol// rgyal po rgyu skar mkhan rjes tshes grangs ni// spo bas bgrang zhing ma 'cham gar mang btsan// dus bzang kun la rgyud chags gsum pa dang*// zla phyed seng ge'i khrir 'khod gnas brtan gyis// so thar mdo yi dang por bya ston nas// gsol ba 'dzin 'jug 'don pa lnga las gang*// brtsams pa sde tshan rdzogs pa ma 'khrul 'don// 'jigs lam sdod du mi btub 'gro bzhin klog /ma tshang gso sbyong byin brlabs bya bar gsungs// zla phyed sbyin bdag zhal ta spyod yul grong*// bsod snyoms nad g.yog gnas kyi bla ma yod// 'thab krol can med mi 'byung der gnas khang*// byi dor gnas mal khri'u chol zangs byas// stobs spro gcig gam du ma bskos nas dbyar// 'bring po'i nya nyin khrims su bya ba brjod// las byed pas gsol brims pa go bar bya// gnas mal rim pa bzhin bstabs bsgo ba dang*// brjod nas phyi de nyin la rang gi gnas// g.yogs par gnas par khas blangs dge slong mdun// phyi ma sngags kyi bye brag dgos pa'i ched// zhag bdun bzhi bcu'i gnang ba sbyin par bya// mi nus dgag dbye 'dun blangs mthun sogs bzhi// byin brlab dgag dbye byed bsko gsol nas su/

rtswa brims gnyis kas gzung mnan dgag dbye ni// gsum gyi'o rkyen gyis gnyis gcig rang nyid gzhan// go bya rdzas blang tshig gi rdzas kyi bya// dmigs bsal tshogs dang gnyis thal gzhan byas so// ma longs byin gyis brlabs po sde lngas so// sra brkyang bgyi dang bsko bya ston 'bring gi /bcu drug nyin par rung ba las kyi gtad// go rim ji bzhin 'ding bzlas re re'i mdun// bting ngo zhes pas go bya gzhan gyis len// dus su gseng brad sprug go khyim sogs min// ma zhig dpyid ra'i nyar dbyung lhags dus nyid// phan yon rnyed pa bcu dang lngas thob min// rgyu bdun gos drug la ni chos gos gnyis// snam sbyar dgu dang bla gos gsum mthang gos// gnyis te tshad ldan rung ba'i tshon gyis bsgyur// ma rnyed phongs la 'khor gsum khebs tsam gnang*// rngul gzan sham thabs gnyis gnyis g.yan pa dgab// gding ba ras chen skra gzed gdong rnag gzan// dras pa gsum ste bcu gsum 'tsho ba dang*// lhag dang mkho dang phran tshegs yo byad bzhi// bsgyur drub 'tsho dang mkho ba lhag pa yis// yo byad rung ba byin brlab mi rung ba// gzhan gyir bsngos la brtag 'os yid brtan bya// brnyan po re zhig par bya bsgo ba lnga// mtha' min phyogs song mi dbang shi ba'i rdzas// yo byad drug ni nad g.yog dbang de yang*// lhag tshe 'bring thob bud med khyim par min// mang tshe phyi ma'o lhag po byin brlabs nas// dge 'dun la'o sham thabs gyon pas ni// mtha' dag byed rung bla gos gtsang ma'i sar// snam sbyar dge 'dun 'dus dang zas dang phyag /grong sogs 'jug tshe bsgo bya gzhan du min// ma g.yogs gnas mal mi rung gzhan med na// bla gos bzhi bltab 'ding ngo ma khyer bas// gnas na gzhan gyi dkar po ma dras rgyur// byin rlabs zas min gos gcig bkag de bzhin// gos med khrus so mang po blang gos gcig

/ma gnang gcig pus bdag gir byar rung min// ska rags be'u ras sogs rjes gnang spyad// dag phyir btso blag mkhan min rang gis bkru// yul dbus mal stan ma gnang stan tsam gyi// mtha' khob mal stan gnyis ka ko pags lham// gnang ngo mig phan dom lpags bcang ba'ang gsungs// nas chan snum mkhur 'bras chan nya sha bza'// sdong bu 'bras bu utpal la sogs bca'// de dag dus rung chu shing sogs brgyad 'bras// btung ba tshags btsags rung chus bslad pa dang*// dar ba khur chu rtsab mo lnga dus min// bur chu thun tshod rung dang zhag bdun pa// bu ram 'bru mar sbrang rtsi mar kha ra// hwags dang zhag lnga yin no 'tsho ba'i sman// rtsa ba sdong bu lo ma me tog 'bras// sman gyi don du gsal lo kha zas min// bsres na dus rung gzhan gsum byin brlab bya// rung ba'i khang bgyis dran pa nyer bzhag nas// lag bsnyal bsod snyoms blangs nad sman shes za// dge 'dun don du grong zhing sogs len gnang*// gsol ba gsol gnyis gsol bzhi nyer bzhi dang*// zhe bdun sum cu mngon sum rjes bsgrag 'du// dge 'dun tshang dang las brjod las byed pa// cho ga bzhin bgyid las kyi gzhi ru gsungs// pham pa 'chab bcas rgyud de gsor mi rung*// 'chab med dge 'dun la ni ji srid 'tshor// bslab pa nos spyad bslab pa'ang dman spyod rnams// len dang khyad spyod rnams spong mtshams nang du// kun la lci bshags yang ba phyi rol bzhir// bcabs lhag spo ba nod spyad dbyung spo bzhin// gnyis byung gzhi nas yang byung lang gzhi nas// bzhi byung nan tur 'chab med mgu ba'ang sbyar// spo bzhin 'chab med gcig byung mgu spyod bzlog /nyi shus phyir lnga lci dang yang nang gcig /gleng bas mi 'chos sdigs smad bskrad dang 'gyed// gnas dbyung ci rigs par sbyar bzod nas mthol// byung rdzas spang lon bshags bya gzhan rnams la// ming dang sde smos sngags kyi gcig mdun du'o// dge tshul dge slong mdun bshags 'chab bcas na// bslab sbyin sdig lta 'dzin na bsnyil bar bya// ma gsum khyad chos cung zad bsgyur ba tsam// bslab pa phul dang shi 'phos rtsa ba chad// lan gsum mtshan gyur shes dang mtshan mo 'das// gtong rgyu yin no rtsod pa zhi bya'i chos// kha sbub ngo bo nyid tshol gso sbyong dang*// dgag dbye bzhag pa dang ni gtong dang len// bye la bzod pa gsol dang mthun pa dang*// gso sbyong gsol ba len gzhug gzugs la sbed// brim dran ma smyos mdun bshags phyir bcos yin// gtsug lag khang byas bcu gnyis gang zag bsko// rgas na 'khar ba drwa ba'i gnang ba sbyin// klog dang klog 'jug rjes su 'jug pas gnas// theg chen la ni ji bzhin rang don du// gzhan don 'gyur ba thams cad de las gnang*// 'dul ba kun las btus pa sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan las nyan thos kyi 'dul ba rnam par bshad pa ste le'u dang po'o/// /

sgo gsum nyes pa ma lus spong byed pa'i// tshul khrims byang sdom shing rta chen po'i srol// rnam gnyis dbye ba rigs sad so thar gyi// sdom ldan gyis len bcu gnyis skye ba'i rgyu// smon lam btab pas chos mthun mkhas pa dang*// ngag rnams rig byed don 'dzin go nus la// sngon btang ston par 'du shes gsol ba btab// skyabs 'gro dmigs la phyag bya ci 'byor mchod// mdun du tsog pu'am pus btsugs smon pa blang*// spro ba bslab dang phan yon brjod pas bsdus// phyag byas rkang par gtugs nas gsol ba btab// dri dang tshogs gsog ston pa'i 'du shes kyis// phyag bya bskul nas dri lan dang ba bskyed// go bya dri dang khas len gyur na byin// mkhyen par gsol dang gzigs 'jug gya tshom min// bslab gzhi phan yon 'jug pa'i cho ga yin// med na sku gzugs spyan sngar rang gis len// sems can mi btang phan yon dran par bya// tshogs gnyis bsag dang yang yang sems sbyang dang*// dkar nag chos brgyad blang dor smon pa'i yin// bla ma mchod 'os bslu dang gzhan 'gyod pa'i// gnas ma yin la 'gyod skyed byang sems la// sdang ba'i tshig smra kun la g.yo sgyu spyod// nag po'i chos so mi nyams byed pa'i chos// srog gi phyir yang brdzun du mi smra dang*// 'gro la lhag bsam dag pas gnas pa dang*// sems bskyed ston par 'du shes yon tan bsgrag /dge la gzhan 'god de yang bla med du'o// 'jug pa'i sems kyi bdag nyid sdom gnas pas// tshul khrims bslab pa gsum la legs par bslab// yang dag blangs pa ris bdun sdom pa dang*// chos bsgrub bsrung dang rnam spel dge chos dang*// bcu gcig sems can don byed rnam gsum du// tshul khrims rnam gzhag gzhan rnams 'dus pa yin// 'das 'dod mi lta ma 'ongs la mi dga'// da lta byung la zhen med dben par dga'// ngag rtog yongs dag bdag nyid khyad mi gsod// des bzod bag yod cho ga 'tsho ba dag

/rnam bcus dang po legs bsdams 'gyur ba yin// sbyin tshul bzod brtson bsam gtan nyer gnas lnga// shes rab lnga ste bcus ni dge chos dang*// sems can bcu gcig po la bcu gcig gis// 'tsham pa'i don byed lhag ma'i legs byed yin// rnyed bkur lhag zhen bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*// ser snas zang zing nor dang chos mi ster/ khro bas gzhan 'tshe shad sbyangs kyis mi zlog /g.yom las chos ltar bcos mos ston pa bzhi// kun dkris chen pos sdom pa 'jig byed pa// pham pa nyid gsung chung dang 'bring la min// rgyun mi chad spyod ngo tsha khrel med dang*// des mgu dga' dang de nyid yon tan du// lta ba de la kun dkris chen po zer// mi mchod 'dod pa dang len rgan sogs la// mi gus dri lan mi brlon 'gron gnyer bar// mi 'gro gser sogs bstabs pa mi len dang*// chos 'dod mi sbyin tshul 'chal sogs 'dor dang*// dad phyir mi slob snying las chung ngur gnas// snying rjes mi bgyid log 'tsho bdag gir spyod// rgod dang mya ngan 'das la rgyab phyogs smra// tshig mi btsun dang don 'gyur byed pa spong*// gshe lan gshe dang khros 'dor khro ba len// 'dod phyir 'khor sdud le lo mi sel dang*// 'du 'dzi'i gtam chags gdam ngag mi nod dang*// sgrib pa dang len bsam gtan ro la blta// nyan thos theg spong de dang mu stegs la// rang tshul dor brtson phyi ma la dga' dang*// theg chen skur 'debs bdag bstod gzhan smod dang*// chos don mi 'gro chos smra khyad gsod dang*// yi ge rton smra sems can bya grogs min// nad par rim gro bral dang sdug mi sel// bag med pa la rigs pa mi ston dang*// phan lan mi 'jal mya ngan mi bsang dang*// 'dod pa mi ster 'khor gyi don mi byed// gzhan blo mi bstun de bsngags mi brjod dang*// 'os pa tshar mi gcod dang rdzu 'phrul gyis// skrag par mi byed zhe drug nga rgyal dang*// kun nas mnar sems kyis spyad nyon mongs can// snyoms sems bag med kyis byas nyon mongs min// brtse dang phan 'dod dgos dbang tshor bas gzir// sems 'khrugs nyes med ngo bo nyid dang ni// byed las bsam pa gzhi las bsags pa lnga// chung 'bring cher dbye phal cher zhe sdang gi'o// pham pas gtong phyir slar blang 'bring ni gsum// tha ma gcig mdun dngos po brjod pas bshags// mthun pas gang zag med na yid kyis bsdam// phul dang smon pa btang dang log ltas gtong*// gzhan du tshe 'phos nas kyang rjes su 'brang*// rnam dag phan yon 'phags pa thogs med lugs// rab dad sems brtan dge ba'i bshes mdun du// yan lag bdun mthar dam bca' tshig brjod pas// smon 'jug cig car blang zhing dga' ba bsgom// med na rang gis sku gzugs sogs las blang*// gang gis rigs dang mi rigs ma brtags par// rtsom mam bzlog gam btang snyoms 'jog pa dang*// 'os las 'das byed thams cad ltung ba'i sde// don chen bsgrub la chung btang gzugs brnyan dang*// nus pa'i yul min thams cad ltung med de// mi nus der brtson de yi gzugs brnyan yin/

gsum gyi dkor 'phrog dang po chos spong gnyis// tshul ldan tshul 'chal 'phrog bsnun btson rar gzhug /srog 'bral bslab pa 'bebs pa gsum pa ste// mtshams med las byed bzhi dang log lta lnga// rgyal po la yin grong ljongs grong khyer dang*// grong brdal yul 'khor 'joms lnga blon po dang*// stong pa nyid brjod phyir log nyan thos smon// rdzogs pa'i byang chub phyir ldog smra byed dang*// so so thar spangs theg chen sbyor ba dang*// nyan thos theg spangs 'dir sbyong nyan blangs dang*// phrag dog dbang gis bdag bstod gzhan smad dang*// rnyed dang bkur sti'i ched du bdag 'tshong dang*// dge slong chad pas spyod 'jug sug 'bul dang*// zhi gnas 'dor zhing spong ba'i longs spyod dag /kha ton byed par sbyin brgyad pham pa la// gtso bor 'byung nyes bzhag gis kun la kun// rtsa ltung nyid 'gyur ming du bco brgyad dang*// rdzas su bcu bzhi de steng byang sems btang*// byang sa'i pham bzhi bsnan pa thun 'das na'o// gsol gdab rmi lam 'phags pa nam snying gi /mdun du 'dug ste bshags sam nyin dang mtshan// lan gsum phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don cing*// rgyal ba sras bcas la brten zhi bar bya// byang sems btang na sdom pa bskyar nas len// gang gis ltung bar mi 'gyur gnas te 'dir// gtong dang bsrung dang dag pa spel ba bzhir// bsdus nas lus dang longs spyod dge ba yi// dbye bas rnam pa bzhi yang gsum gsum 'gyur// sems can kun la lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba ster ba gtong ba yin// bshes gnyen bsten dang chos 'dzin gnod gyur spong*// mi mthun bdud kyi las dang mi dge'i bshes// byang sems brjed dang 'khrul dang mi mos dang*// zhal ta byed pa'i gnod pa rtsa ltung dang*// rab byung bar chad byed dang mi dge'i lam// dge rtsa byed pa'i bar gcod rgyal sras la// phrag dog de la khong khro sgrib pa dang*// byang sems brnyas dang chos spong chos smra ba// khyad du gsod pa de yi gnod pa yin// dran pa bcu gnyis brten las gus pa 'byung*// de las zhi ba de las yang dag pa// ji bzhin shes skye de phyir ting nge 'dzin// don gnyer dran shes dang tshul can du bya// tshul khrims ting 'dzin gcig gis gcig 'phel ba// 'di gnyis kyis ni sems yongs sbyong ba 'grub// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa 'dir zad cing*// 'di ni chos rnams kun gyi rtsa ba yin// gang gis rang nyid mthong ba'i de ma thag

/dga' dang rangs par 'gyur ba lus kyis spyad// 'jam ran snyan par smra ba ngag gis dang*// nga yir med pa'i zhi ba sems kyis gzung*// gtan du ba dang na ba'i rkyen sman dang*// gos la sred pa nyon mongs can ltung phyir// gnas gsum dran pa nyer bzhag de longs spyad// 'di rnams lus bsrung legs spyad tshod rigs pa// longs spyod bsrung yin rang don rnam smin la// sred spangs 'gyod par mi bya bsgrags pa min// thob dang bkur stir 'jigs bya khengs pa spongs// chos la som nyi dor ba dge bsrung ngo*// stobs bzhi sdig spyod bzod bya thos pa btsal// nags gnas mnyam par bzhag bya mi sdug dang*// byams dang rten 'brel dran pa nyer bzhag bsgom// stong nyid 'jug pa nyon mongs sbyong pa ste// lus dang yang dag 'tsho spyad longs spyod dang*// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyis spyod// dge ba de dag dag pa gsum du bzhag /stobs skyed le lo med pa lus spel dang*// stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyis sbyin// longs spyod spel dang dang por brtson pa dang*// bsam pa gtan par nan tan byas nas su// snying rje mdun bzhag dge ba spel ba ni// bzang po spyod pa'i cho ga sogs bzhin bya// dad sogs bsgom zhing byams dang dkon mchog gsum// rjes dran kun tu sems can don bya dang*// chos sbyin byang sems dge ba spel ba'i rgyu// yang dag spong dang bag yod dran shes bzhi// kun la 'jug pa'i don bsdu 'di dag ni// bslab btus las gsungs klu sgrub ring lugs so// tshul gnyis shing rta gang gis bzhon pa de// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bgrod la dka' ba ci// 'dul ba kun las btus pa sdom pa gsum gyi rgyan las byang chub sems dpa'i 'dul ba rnam par bshad pa ste le'u gnyis pa'o/// / lus ngag yid gsum thabs shes kyis zin par// bsdams pa'i tshul khrims sngags sdom dbye ba ni// bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med rgyud gsungs pa'i// phyi ma dbang bskur dbye bas rnam bzhir bshad// bya ba med par mnyam bzhag mi nus pa// rig gtad rjes su gnang dang dbang bskur ba// gang rung las nod 'di yi dbang bskur ni// chu dbang phyag rgya spyi bor gtug pa dang*// brgyud 'dzin rjes gnang tsam ste rtsa rgyud las// dbang lnga gsungs pa chu dbang lan lnga ru// bskur na dgos pas rgyud bstan der zad cing*// dkyil chog 'ga' las rnal 'byor rgyud bzhin bsgrags// de tshe dam tshig dag kyang de dang mtshungs// dkon mchog gsum la dad pa rab bskyed dang*// gsang sngags rigs sngags gzungs sngags tshogs la dad// theg pa che la khyad par mos par bya// bla ma dam tshig can dang mdza' bor gus// lha la dus mtshams dag /de dang de nas myur du bzlog nas su// gsang sngags yi ge mchod la legs par sbyar// rtse gcig sems las bzlas brjod thogs med 'grub// gsang sngags lha dang zlos la sdang mi bya// gzhan gzhung mi mchod gsang sngags rang bzor min// ma gnang mi len gdon sogs las mi bya// gzhan du mi spyod dam tshig med mi sbyin// phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshan ma mi 'gong zhing*// zas dang spyod la sgo gsum ma bsdams min// ma gnang mi za byams pa gtang mi bya// zlos nas ma zin bar du smra ba min// khros nas drag shul mi spyod bdag mi brnyas// gzhan sun mi 'byin gnas ngan len rnams spong*// ltad mo mi blta ser sna rgyags khengs bskyungs// bshang gci chu'am de dang nyer mi dor// bco brgyad 'di dag dgag pa'i dam tshig go /sha chang ke'u sgog gtsong 'bru mar dang*// til dang la phug 'byung po'i kha zas dang*// lha bshos gtor ma la sogs ma gnang zas// chad lta dkon mchog gsum spong byang sems spong*// dbang bskur spong dang bla mar 'khu ba lnga// 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las gsungs dpung bzang gis// zhus las mtshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga// snying nas dkon mchog gnod byed bcu gcig go /spyi rgyud gsum las gsungs pa'i brtul zhugs kyi// rnam par dbye ba thams cad der 'dus so// gal te nyams na rang rigs snying po'i sngags// 'bum du bzlas brjod mes rmongs byed pa'i gzungs// stong dam yang na zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg gam// yang na dkyil 'khor 'jug pas dag par bya// de dag bya ba'i rgyud kyi 'jug pa ste// de yi sbyor ba khrus byas stan gnas pas// spyan drangs mchod nas mdun du rang rigs dang*// bstun pa'i skyil krung gis 'dug byang sems dang*// sgra dang yi ge gzugs dang phyag rgya dang*// mtshan ma'i lha zhes drug ni rim bzhin bsgom// mdun dang rang snying yi ge sgrar dmigs bzlas// 'di ni ting 'dzin rnam bcas sbyor ba ste// gsang sngags mer gnas dngos grub ster dang gzhan// sgra gnas rnal 'byor ster ba dran dang ni// sgra mthar thar pa ster ba rnam gsum po// don dam rang bzhin gnyis su med sbyor shes// lus rdzas longs spyod 'grub dang de gsum gyis// gzhan don byed pa grub pa'i spyod par bshad/// /

bya ba mang min kho na nyid mos pa// snying rje chen po 'byung ba'i dkyil 'khor dang*// yi ge 'khor lo bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// las dang bya spangs phyag rgya'i dbang bskur dang*/ de gnyis bris par smra log lta ltung ba'i rtsa ba bzhi// dgur gsungs spong dang bsgyur ba byang sdom dang*// 'dir gsungs khyad par phyir bcos gong dang 'dra// yi ge dang po byang sems stong nyid bsgom// yi ge gnyis pa sngags dang sgrar ldang zhing*// gzhi dang rang lus sangs rgyas skur bskyed pa// sngags dang phyag rgya sogs kyis byin gyis brlab// gzhi gnyis mdun du sangs rgyas sku bskyed nas// thugs kar zla ba sngags phreng bkod ting 'dzin// brtan byed mtshan bcas mtshan ma med pa ni// lus sems rnam shes sgyu ma ltar dran pas// byang chub sems bsgom chos kun ngo bo nyid// med par rtogs pa'i ting 'dzin brtan byed pa'o// 'di dag spyod pa'i rgyud kyi 'jug pa yin// phyi nang mtshan med bzlas brjod sbyor ba ste// 'bar ba'i rdzas blang phyi dang sa thob nang*// gnyis po grub pa'i spyod pa yin par gsungs/// / bya ba g.yengs shes kho na nyid mos pa// nyon mongs cha mnyam shas cher spyod pa yang*// rigs mthun dkyil 'khor rgyas dang phyag rgya bzhi// phyag rgya gcig pa gang rung sgor zhugs nas// slob ma'i dbang lnga slob dpon dbang nod bya// gsum la skyabs 'gro rnam par snang mdzad dang*// rdor dril phyag rgya slob dpon gzung ba bzhi// rdo rje'i rigs so chos dang zang zing dang*// mi 'jigs byams pa sbyin bzhi rin chen dang*// phyi nang gsang ba theg gsum 'dzin pa gsum// padma'i rigs dang sdom 'dzin mchod pa gnyis// las kyi rigs so de bzlog phas pham yin// srog gcod ma byin len dang 'dod log /mi byed lha brnyas phyag rgya bzhon pa sogs// 'god par mi bya rjes mthun bsrung bya'o// sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba rdor sems dang*// 'dod chags snyoms zhugs de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// de bzhin khro bo cher ston rdo rje dang*// rang bzhin dag shes dgos pa de dang de// byed pa padma rin chen la 'dod sbyin// nyams len dam tshig nyams na bzlas pa dang*// zhi ba'i sbyin bsreg dbang nod sogs kyis 'chos// 'jug pa'i sgo yin dang por sbyor ba dang*// dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal rnam pa gsum// mi nus rnal 'byor rjes su rnal 'byor dang*// thams cad rnal 'byor shin tu rnal 'byor lnga// slob dpon dbang byas rnal 'byor che yang ste// lha bsang cho ga rab dang dman pa la// tshig dang rdor bzlas bsnan pa thabs su gsungs// rdzogs pa'i byang chub de yi 'bras bu yin/// / utpal pad gnyis tsan dan rin chen nam// don gnyer gnyis sam las dang sbyangs pa can// gang rung slob mas bla ma legs brtags nas// slob dpon smin pa'i las kyis slob ma rnams// dkyil 'khor bzhi la rim bcug slob dpon bzhi// rim par bsnyen nas dbang bzhi rim pas blang*// bum pa gsang ba shes rab bzhi pa'i dbang*// rnal 'byor chen po'i rgyud 'dir grags pa yin// dri ma bzhi dag nus pa bzhi smin la// yongs su smin par bzhag pas gang gi de// byed nus thabs la rgyal bas dbang bskur gsungs// de phyir dbang bskur de med dngos grub med// gal te cho ga'i go rim 'di kho nas// smin byed gzhan la de yi nus med na// rgyal bas cho ga mi mthun ci ste gsungs// bsam pa mkhyen pas smin byed sna tshogs bstan// de bas mu bzhi dbang la 'thad bzhin du// brtsis par skyon smre mkhas pa'i bsnyon dor yin// bum dbang dkyil 'khor rdul tshon las gzhan pa// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lor gsungs bzhin du// smin byed rdul tshon nyid du bskur dgos pa'i// sgrub byed gleng ba ri bong cal dang mtshungs// 'ga' zhig sngags la sngon chog da chog 'byed// rgyud dang 'phags yul gzhung las de ma bshad// rnal 'byor rgyud dang bla med sdom pa la/

khyad par med smra rang sdom rang nyid kyi// nyams len dngos gzhi yin pa ma shes gtam// bum dbang dus rdzogs smra ba de dang mtshungs// la la sdom gzung dus su 'di rdzogs zer// rigs su ma skyes de yi brtul zhugs ci// dbang med sngags 'di'i rtsa ltung 'byung bas gnod// slob dpon brnyas dang bka' 'das spun la khro// byams btang byang sems spong dang chos la smod// gsang sgrogs phung po brnyas dang mtha' smod// snod dang cho ga ma byas ma rdzogs dang*// nyams dang zab mos 'jigs lngar gsang bya bstan// phung po lnga la sdang dang brnyas pa dang*// smod dang gdung bas yid mi bde skyed pa// gang gi rang bzhin dag par bkri ba'i chos// gzhi lam 'bras bu'i tshul la the tshom za// mngon spyod bya 'os yul la mdza' ba'am// yan lag tshang ba nus bzhin ma bsgral ba// ming sogs bral la ji bzhin mi 'jug par// dngos sam dngos med du rtog rgyal ba'i chos// rtog ge ngan pas rang dbang 'jal ba yang*// dad gsum ldan la nyams dang don mi byed// sems mi bsrung dang ched du bslu ba yin// skabs bab yo byad longs spyod dam tshig rdzas// brten du yod bzhin bsams nas mi brten pa// spyi dang bye brag la ltos shes rab ma// ngos dang lkog tu snying tshim smad go la'o// yul bsam sbyor ba dus dang nyes pa dang*// lan grangs drug gis de bsgyur brgyad cu bzhi// lci 'bring yang ba gsum gyis slar bsgyur ba// nyis brgya lnga bcu rtsa gnyis rtsa ltung sde// yul bsam sbyor ba dus kyi shan 'dra rnams// de cha der gtogs pham ltung lci sbom dang*// yan lag nyes byas phra mo'i brtsi bas shes// na dang dbang nyams bya ba gzhan gyis dang*// don chen skye med brtan dang dgos ldan dang*// nus rnyed gnang dang bka' bsgo bar chad las// thams cad nyes pa med par gsungs pa yin// rig ma brten dga' tshogs rtsod bdud rtsi len// gzhan la mi ston dad la gzhan gtam byed// nyan thos nang 'dug sngags pa yin zer dang*// snod min la bshad yan lag ltung ba brgyad// ma sbyangs bdag gir mi byed rig ma bsten// der 'phya ba yang tshogs kyi nang du rtsod// cho ga mi ldan rig ma'i bdud rtsi len// gsang chos shes kyang bsam ngan gyis mi ston// dad ldan chos dri ba la gzhan ston dang*// nyan thos sogs nang zhag bdun 'das pa dang*// gsang sngags de nyid mi shes sngags par smra// bsnyen sogs dag par ma byas ston pa dang*// phyi chos la mos de la gsang ba ston// gsang rdzas phyag rgya 'ching ba mi sbed pa'o// rang lha dor dang dus 'das lha gzhan dga'// rig byed la zhen ma rdzogs rdzogs byed dang*// 'jig rten chos ched khyad gsod gong min tshul// phrin las ma gtogs don med gnas byams gtong*// dman spyod zang zing rtog pa yongs mi 'dzin// rang spyod dor ba bco lnga'o dam pa bsten// snod brtag 'dod phyir gnod spangs dkon mchog nor// mi len gzhan don mi 'dor byang chub dang*// mi mthun dge la 'jug min 'pho ba shes// de bzlog bdun no sngags la the tshom za// theg pa gsum spangs gcig tu sbyor ba dang*// de nyid bcu la mi gnas dbang bskur dang*// bdud brtag mi mkhas sems pa dus la 'das// phra mo mi bshags drug ste nyer brgyad bsdebs// slong mos rgyu dang rnal 'byor spang ba dang*// rgyun du mi 'da' dam tshig sogs mi bsten// bzhi rnams yan lag ltung ba dag tu gsungs// 'dod pa'i rdo rje rdor dril phyag rgya dang*// bla ma gzung bgyi rin chen la sbyin pa// 'khor lor rgyal mchog dam tshig bskyang ba dang*// ral gri mchod bgyi chu skyes rigs la sdom// rgyal ba skyed mdzad rigs la byang chub sems// srog gcod mi bden gzhan nor bud med 'phrog

/lnga sogs brten dang padmar mi smad pa// rim bzhin rdo rje ral gri rin chen dang*// padma 'khor lo gri gug rigs la gsungs// yo byad longs spyod mnyam bzhag rjes spyod bzhir// bsdus nas rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya drug /kha ṭwāṃ cang te'u padma'i snod bgrang 'phreng*// bris sku glegs bam mchod phyir thogs dang gzhan// glang chen lpags sogs yo byad dam tshig yin// 'dod pa lnga dang sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga// btung ba lnga dang phyag rgya lnga longs spyod// bdun cu rtsa gnyis sha yang mchod dus brten// srog chags gsod dang brdzun gyi tshig smra dang*// ma byin par len gzhan gyi bud med brten// rang gi lus la srog bkag srog gcod de// phung sogs chos rnams 'od gsal gzhug la dgongs// cig car sems can kun gyi skad so sor// chos ston gzhom med sgra ni brdzun smra zhes// rten 'byung bden med ston pa'i phyir gyis gsungs// lus kyi thig le bzhi rnams gsang gnas su// byang chub sems gzugs gcig gyur de nyid kyi// sha chen bza' ba 'du byed phung po ni// sgrib bral byed pa sku dang gsung la ni// ngag gi thig bzhi lte bar gcig gyur pas// bshang gci bza' ba gzugs phung sgrib bral dang*// thugs kyi thig bzhi snying kar gcig gyur pas// khu khrag bza' ba tshor 'du sgrib bral du// byed pa thugs kyi dam tshig 'dus par gsungs// de steng ye shes thig bzhi mgrin par gcig /go ku da ha na bza' mig sogs lnga// khams dang skye mched chos kun sgrib bral du// dag pa ye shes dam tshig dus 'khor du'o// sangs rgyas ye shes rang stobs kyis len phyir// de dag ma byin len du bzhag pa yin// dngos grub rgyu dang dam tshig rnams bskyed dang*// rigs gzhan pho nyar mi bgrod gnyis med dang*// dam tshig rnam spyod thogs pa med pa dang*// mi mo'i spyod bsrub tshangs par spyod pa'i zhal// 'dren pa rtsa yi kun spyod rnam pa brgyad// bde mchog las gsungs des don de dbye yin// rnam kun stong nyid rdor sems bud med de// mi 'gyur bde ba rnyed pa de la sbyor// gzhan gyi bud med rten gsungs dgongs pa'i don// stong nyid dang ni 'gyur med bde ba yi// dam tshig gnyis sam zung 'jug dam tshig tu// sngags kyi dam tshig sdom pa thams cad bsdus// sangs rgyas sa yang dam tshig chen por gsungs// stong nyid dam tshig kun rdzob dbang byas dang*// don dam 'gyur med zung 'jug don gcig tu// shes pas ma yengs lam gyis de bsgrub pa// sngags kyi dam tshig kun gyi rtsa ba yin// de phyir rang sems 'dul ba rgyal bas kyang*// 'dul ba'i chos kyi nying khu yin par gsungs// mnyam par bzhag pa'i dam tshig der shes bya// 'tshe dang mi bden gzhan nor gzhan bud med// myos par chang 'thung lnga dang cho lo rtse// kha na ma tho'i zas za tshig ngan dang*// 'byung po dang ni lha min chos klog dang*// ba glang byis pa bud med skyes pa dang*// lha mi'i bla ma gsod lnga grogs dang rje// sangs rgyas dge 'dun yid brtan bla mar 'khu// lnga dang gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya lngar// chags rnams mi byed brtul zhugs nyer lnga yin// rgyun gyi bya dang mchod pa'i de nyid dang*// gsang sba rig pa'i pho nya sngags bzla dang*// zhing la gus dang spyod pa'i brtul zhugs dang*// thos bsam dang ni sgrub po byin brlab dgu

sngags bzla brtul zhugs dam tshig sems can skyong*// sangs rgyas mchod dang dzam lar chu sbyin dang*// dge las tsha tsha 'debs pa bcu bzhir gsungs// gzhan yang dam tshig 'bum sde rgyud las gsungs// de'i phyir rgyud gzhung blta la nan tan bya// dbang bdun gnas la rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung*// de tshe lha grangs re rer bzlas pa ni// sum khri drug stong byas phyis bsdams pas 'dag /bum gsang gnas pa sngon du chad las spyad// phyis nas dkyil 'khor zhugs nas bka' nod bya// de tshe'ang thu bo'i ming ni chung ngur 'gyur// gong ma gnyis gnas bsod nams tshul khrims kyi// tshogs bsags sdig bshags rang rgyud byin rlabs kyis// dag bya gzhan gyi rkyen gyis 'dag mi nus// tshul 'di dang po'i sangs rgyas rgyud chen du'o// tshogs zhing la bshags dral ba'i sngags rgya dang*// bkru ba'i rim pa gtum mos bsreg pa dang*// mi dmigs bsgom dang dbang bzhi blang ba dang*// tshogs su zhu dang rten la sme ba dang*// maṇḍal 'bul dang mchod rten bya ba dang*// me la sbyangs dang gtor ma btang ba dang*// gsang sngags bzla dang zab mo'i bsam gtan dang*// srog skyab bka' klog bla ma bsten pa dang*// bdag 'jug rgyal ba'i yig brgya dus bzang bzlas// phung po gsum pa rdor sems bla ma dang*// thig le phra mo'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa ste// phyir bcos nyer lnga snying po'i rgyan las gsungs// rim pa gnyis ni grol byed lam yin la// spyod pa bzhi ni de yi bogs 'don yin// dam tshig skyon med bsrung de 'di nyid dam// pa'i dpes// dgag bsgrub gong ma gtso bo'i blang dor bstan// ston pa'i gzhung gi chu gter la zhugs pas// brjod tshig klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor// thob nas gzhan phan ched du mchod pa 'di// skal bzang ded dpon padma dkar pos byas// thar lam don du gnyer bas skom rnams la// legs bshad 'di ni bdud rtsi'i chu gter te// mkhas dbang snying la kun dga'i gzugs brnyan ni// ci yang bri ba'i ri mo mkhan du'ang mthong*// dgos don ri bong gzugs kyis rnam mdzes pa// tshig don 'od dkar bye bas legs bskor nas// bsdus don shar ri'i rtser bkod zla ba 'di// thub bstan ku mud gnyen du gnas gyur cig
